title: G2 retrieval security review
summary: The read-only review found no blocking issue in T-030 through T-033 and conditionally cleared T-037 to proceed after its named gates.
evidence: Tenant scope, canonical database immutability, rollback completeness, and scope containment passed.
sqlite-vec compatibility remained 9 of 9 and the FTS5 shadow artifact remained isolated from the canonical database.
Application-level sqlite-vec load failure must degrade safely before vector KNN reaches production.
Embedding-model provenance must be recorded before any model migration.
Five unsupported-topic evaluation questions remain named quality gaps, and the legal-guidance case must refuse before production exposure.
limitations: This review does not authorize deployment or production exposure. T-037 remains subject to its ownership, enablement, latency, and integration gates.
